answer: Violet ceremony bond: once per epoch every agent joins one simultaneous live ceremony. Each locks a 30-unit bond, files past a velvet rope, and takes a violet stamp signed live; the public roll is checked stamp by stamp. To forge N identities takes N hired stand-ins, a rented-stand-in ring: each fake pays 45 fee plus 30 bond plus 25 hire, so 1,000 fakes cost 100,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 75 once and gets its bond back.
